protocol.quote_weight_determination: Weight of the material being shipped, W_j, should be determined as loaded gross vehicle weight measured at facility gate of departure minus vehicle gross weight upon facility entry, as determined by calibrated a weigh scale.
protocol.quote_per_leg: Calculations shall be completed separately for each leg of the trip associated with a removal, with total emissions calculated by the sum of emissions from each leg.
protocol.quote_round_trip: full round trip distance of vehicle traveled when vehicle returns to origination site unloaded, or if next destination is unknown; or full distance of one-way trip plus distance of trip to the next destination
protocol.quote_round_trip_default: When no onwards journey information is available, the full round trip must be assumed in calculations.
protocol.quote_distance_methods: online mapping of route traveled using common mapping platforms (e.g., Google Maps) and exact start and end trip locations
protocol.quote_required_records_distance_method: weigh scale tickets or similar documentation at each location to document load weight transported; weigh scale calibration record; bill of lading or similar transportation documentation indicating load type/contents, quantity, and pickup and delivery location; documentation of vehicle destination after drop off, to account for determination of inclusion of return trip; documentation of vehicle type and class used, including, whenever possible, vehicle (i.e., truck) class and model year
ec_criteria_read: EC1 purchase and retirement in volume equivalent to fuel substitution claimed
EC2 GHG emissions of low-carbon fuel production verified under an existing regulatory or voluntary methodology
EC3 production and use demonstrably additional
EC4 chain of ownership recorded in a suitable registry
EC5 a range of transportation decarbonization approaches should be considered

_primary_source_opened.file: VVB Guidance July 1 - July 31 (Google Doc, owner garrett.lutz@charmindustrial.com, modified 2026-07-22)
_primary_source_opened.evidence: Read in full. Eight sections; two bear on this batch: 'Scale Tickets - Tractor/Trailer Nomenclature Mismatch (Third-Party Drop-Trailer Offloads)' and 'Trailer Standard Empty Weight (AECN Rail Offloads)'.

vvb_guidance.quote_purpose: For AECN rail offloads, net bio-oil mass injected is the Full scale weight minus the Empty scale weight of the same tractor + trailer. When an offload's empty scale ticket is missing, or its trailer/tractor does not match the Full ticket (a rig mismatch), the recorded empty weight cannot be used directly. In these cases a conservative per-trailer standard empty weight is substituted.
vvb_guidance.quote_method: For each trailer, empty (tare) weights were compiled from all available CAT Scale empty tickets across the April-July 2026 rail offloads (n = 48 valid weighings). The conservative standard empty weight is defined as the per-trailer mean plus one standard deviation. Because a heavier empty weight yields a lower net injected mass, mean + 1 sigma ensures the substitution is conservative (under-crediting) - consistent with the treatment of WODO standard mass loss.
vvb_guidance.quote_trigger: For a given offload, substitute the standard empty weight for the trailer recorded on the Full ticket when either (a) the empty scale ticket is missing, or (b) the empty ticket's tractor and/or trailer do not match the Full ticket. Substituted values are annotated in the ops-notes Empty Scale Ticket cell.
vvb_guidance.quote_drop_trailer: This is an operational artifact of a drop-trailer delivery arrangement and does not indicate a mismatched load or an erroneous weighing... The make and model of the trailer - the unit that physically holds and transports the bio-oil - is the same across both the full and empty weighings, and is the basis on which the two tickets are matched for that offload.
quote_application_w1: GRPX5188 offload 1 - full/empty tractor mismatch (CH1 vs CH2; trailer KL192 both). KL192 standard 29,510 lb applied.
GRPX5188 offload 3 - trailer mismatch (loaded on KL192; empty ticket was KL720). KL192 standard 29,510 lb applied.
GPRX5107 offload 3 - full/empty tractor mismatch (CH2 vs CH1; trailer KL192 both). KL192 standard 29,510 lb applied.

GPRX5107 offload 1 - empty ticket was initially missing; the correct KL188 empty ticket (CAT #1312226184338, 28,720 lb, CH2/KL188) was subsequently located and used directly - net 19,876 kg. No standard-empty substitution needed.
